svg.title: product-catalog-service — Spring Boot API with measured query optimization
svg.desc: Spring Boot REST API over MySQL with a Redis cache, built from an empty folder in 16 documented phases (10 done). Search with filters, sorting and pagination, Redis cache-aside with MySQL fallback, optimistic locking, RFC 9457 errors, 107 tests including a Redis outage. On 100,000 products, measured indexes made storefront queries 73 to 483 times faster: home newest 42.2 to 0.087 ms, category by price 37.8 to 0.084 ms, price range in stock 41.3 to 0.112 ms, name search 48.6 to 0.664 ms. One documented regression: a rare-word search went from 44.5 to 193 ms.
